title: E-Z Pack Trucks — claimed by wallstreet
description: US · Transportation · E-Z Pack Trucks (E-Z Pack Manufacturing) is a U.S. maker of refuse and recycling truck bodies and related parts. Its product range includes front loaders, rear loaders, and automated or manual side loaders, designed for municipal and commercial waste-collection fleets. The company emphasizes durable equipment, hydraulics, and support for demanding collection routes. Its headquarters are in Cynthia
